body:
## Why

This is a current break on the strict configuration path. `src/trend_analysis/config/model.py:344-353` coerces `portfolio.cost_model.per_trade_bps` and `half_spread_bps` with `float()` but only rejects negative values, so `nan` and `inf` validate on `CostModelSettings`. `src/trend_analysis/config/models.py:510-517` repeats the incomplete check on the runtime mapping path used by `load_config`. A direct reproduction on tip `adda9a41` accepted `{per_trade_bps: inf, half_spread_bps: nan}` through `load_config`; `src/trend_analysis/metrics/turnover.py:39-50` can then propagate non-finite transaction costs. `tests/test_trend_analysis_config_model.py` covers negative and over-range turnover but not non-finite cost inputs on the pydantic models.

## Scope

Reject non-finite `portfolio.cost_model` basis-point fields at every supported configuration boundary before turnover math runs.

## Tasks

- [ ] Update `src/trend_analysis/config/model.py` `CostModelSettings._validate_cost` to reject `nan`, positive infinity, and negative infinity after numeric coercion.
- [ ] Update `src/trend_analysis/config/models.py` cost-model validation so both `per_trade_bps` and `half_spread_bps` require `math.isfinite` before assignment.
- [ ] Extend `tests/test_trend_analysis_config_model.py` with `test_cost_model_rejects_non_finite_values` covering strict-model and `load_config` mapping inputs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `pytest tests/test_trend_analysis_config_model.py::test_cost_model_rejects_non_finite_values -q` passes and proves `nan`, `inf`, and `-inf` are rejected for both cost fields through the strict and runtime configuration paths.
- Deliberate-break → revert: temporarily remove the finite-value guard from `src/trend_analysis/config/model.py` `CostModelSettings._validate_cost` → `tests/test_trend_analysis_config_model.py::test_cost_model_rejects_non_finite_values` must fail → revert the mutation.
- `pytest tests/test_turnover_vectorization.py -q` passes, confirming finite transaction-cost calculations retain their existing contract.

## Non-Goals

- Do not change supported non-negative basis-point semantics or add an arbitrary upper limit.
- Do not alter turnover formulas in `src/trend_analysis/metrics/turnover.py`.
- Scaffold-only completion does NOT count: guarding only `src/trend_analysis/config/model.py` while `load_config` still accepts non-finite values is a failure of this issue.

_Surfaced by Track D repo-audit 2026-09-23; verified by `load_config` reproduction on tip `adda9a41`._
